name: Trimethylolpropane triacrylate
description: Trimethylolpropane triacrylate , widely recognized in the industry as TMPTA, is a trifunctional acrylate monomer used as a reactive crosslinker and diluent in UV- and EB-curable systems. Its three acrylate groups enable rapid network formation, making it a standard building block in radiation-curable formulations across coatings, adhesives, and inks. The CAS 15625-89-5 material is essential for high-performance applications. In UV-curable coatings for automotive and industrial substrates, it increases crosslink density, improving scratch resistance and chemical durability of the cured film. Printing ink formulators use it as a reactive diluent. This allows for precise control of viscosity without sacrificing cure speed or print resolution in energy-curable offset and flexographic inks. In adhesives and sealants, it contributes to cohesive strength and dimensional stability. Electronics manufacturers incorporate it into conformal coatings and encapsulants where fast cure and thermal resistance are process requirements. It is supplied as a low-viscosity liquid in drum and IBC quantities. The product is available in standard technical and industrial grades, with some suppliers offering low-skin-sensitization variants. Specifications are generally aligned with reactive monomer industry standards. Material is commonly evaluated against viscosity, acid value, and inhibitor content to ensure consistency. It meets rigorous industrial requirements for high-speed manufacturing and durable end-use performance. Contact us for supply of Trimethylolpropane triacrylate Request Quote
